breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the thin-walled tube approximation (shear flow q = T/(2·A_m), then τ = q/t) to compute the maximum shear stress, arriving at ≈36.9 MPa. The ground truth requires the exact thick-walled torsion formula τ_max = T·ro/J using J = π(do⁴ − di⁴)/32. The correct result would be τ_max = (450000 × 30) / (751,000) ≈ 17.97 MPa, which is substantially different. The agent repeated the flawed thin-walled model for stress even though it correctly applied J for the angle of twist.
